summary: No security findings. The change is internal bot strategy: src/bots/tag.ts adds a static derived preflop chart (TAG_SHORT_HANDED_CHART) and tagChartFor(dealtIn), selected from view.players.length, which is engine-produced state, not untrusted input; an unknown count falls through to undefined (the shared chart), so there is no failure path. src/playtest/style-check.ts mirrors the same selection. tag.json changes only a constant description string (bundled, not user-editable). No new input, parsing, storage, network, DOM/HTML output, dependency or secret. Randomness is unchanged: card dealing is untouched, and TAG's mixed-spot draws still use the existing seeded botRandom, which is intended for replayable bot behaviour, not fairness. The test-only edit to summary.acceptance.test.ts and the package.json test:slow addition carry no runtime exposure. A diff-wide scan for secrets found nothing.
